I need a question that separates bread from pizza. "Is it soft?" fits bread better than pizza, though pizza could also be called soft. "Is it round?" fits pizza more, but bread can be round too. "Is it flat?" fits pizza better than bread. "Is it usually found in a kitchen?" probably gets yes for both. Of these, "flat" or "soft" seems the cleanest split, and I'll pick flat.
